errors.text_span: Оста Y е обозначена като "Х/Л. лв."
errors.evidence: The y-axis label is "хил.лв." (thousands BGN), not "Х/Л. лв." as stated in the description.
The blue line ends at approximately 700,000 in 2022, not 600,000.
The orange line ends at approximately 180,000 in 2022, not 220,000.
The gray line, representing material recycling, starts at approximately 420,000 in 2018, not 500,000.

errors.text_span: Няма ясно изразени върхове или спадове, които да бъдат отбелязани освен посочените тенденции.
errors.evidence: This statement is incorrect. The gray line has a clear peak in 2019 and a significant dip in 2020. The orange line also has a peak in 2019.
The description of the gray line as a simple 'tendency of increase' completely omits its actual path, which includes a visually prominent dip in 2020.
The description fails to mention that in addition to the solid lines and markers, there are also dotted trend lines for each of the three categories.
